detailed_description:
The target video is a premium, cinematic 15-second product advertisement in a dark, moody studio environment with high-contrast spotlighting, deep black backgrounds, and a reflective black surface that mirrors the hero product. No dialogue, no voiceover, no subtitles; the only visible text is the can's own verbatim packaging text.
[Shot 1] The video opens on near-total darkness in a studio. <Subject 1>, the Heineken Original can from <Picture 1>, stands perfectly centered on a glossy reflective black surface, its mirror reflection visible beneath it. A single overhead spotlight gradually brightens, slowly unveiling the can's glossy green aluminum body with its subtle carbonation-bubble texture, silver metallic top and bottom rims, the red five-pointed star with white outline, the white "HEINEKEN ORIGINAL" arc, the "DIPLOME D'HONNEUR" and "AMSTERDAM · EST. 1873" banners, the large white lowercase "Heineken" logotype, and the "PURE MALT LAGER" tagline. The camera holds a static wide-to-medium framing with a restrained slow push-in toward the can. A quiet studio room tone underlies the reveal.
[Shot 2] At 00:04.000, the shot cuts to a locked-off medium close-up of <Subject 1>. Cold condensation droplets bead across the green surface and begin to trickle slowly down the can's curved body, catching the light. A ring of glistening, frost-covered ice cubes slides smoothly into frame around the can's base. Cool blue-white light rays sweep slowly across the frame from the left, glinting off the red star, the silver rims, and the wet droplets. Soft condensation drips and gentle ice clinks are audible.
[Shot 3] At 00:09.000, the shot cuts to a slow, smooth, controlled close-up orbit around <Subject 1>, arcing gently to showcase the craftsmanship: the crisp white "Heineken" logotype, the metallic top tab, and the "PURE MALT LAGER" tagline pass through sharp focus as the camera moves. Beside the can, <Subject 2>, a freshly poured glass of golden lager with fine bubbles rising through it, sits softly out of focus at the orbit's edge, catching warm highlights. A subtle fizz and faint liquid-settling sound comes from the glass.
[Shot 4] At 00:13.000, the shot cuts to a static hero pose: <Subject 1> stands perfectly centered under a clean, bright spotlight on the reflective black surface, condensation droplets sparkling on its green body, its mirror reflection crisp below. The framing holds steady to the final frame, ending on the can exactly as it appears in <Picture 1>.
